Major AI Developments.title: AI-powered traffic systems to curb violations in Himachal’s Nurpur
Major AI Developments.summary: Nurpur police have implemented an AI-powered Intelligent Traffic Management System (ITMS) to enforce traffic rules and issue e-challans. The system includes the installation of CCTV cameras, funded by a Rs 20 lakh grant, to enhance surveillance in areas such as Jassur town. The initiative aims to curb traffic violations and improve overall road safety in the region.
